Default MOSuite color palette

Source: R/data.R
mosuite_palette.Rd

A character vector of 12 hex color codes used as the default palette throughout MOSuite plots. Colors are assigned to groups in the order they appear (or by factor level order). Use set_color_pal() to override the palette for a specific metadata column.

Usage

mosuite_palette

Format

A character vector of length 12.

See also

select_mosuite_colors(), set_color_pal()

Examples

mosuite_palette
#>  [1] "#5954d6" "#e1562c" "#b80058" "#00c6f8" "#d163e6" "#00a76c" "#ff9287"
#>  [8] "#008cf9" "#006e00" "#796880" "#FFA500" "#878500"
scales::show_col(mosuite_palette)
